input: Write a short op-ed for the community newsletter

gold.taskTitle: Write a Short Op-Ed for Community Newsletter
gold.taskDescription: Write a short opinion piece to be published in a community newsletter.

questions.title: What specific topic or issue will the op-ed address?
questions.description: Identify the exact subject matter or argument the op-ed will focus on.

questions.title: Which community or neighborhood does this newsletter serve?
questions.description: Clarify the geographic or organizational community the newsletter represents.

questions.title: What is the submission deadline for this piece?
questions.description: Determine when the finished op-ed must be submitted.

questions.title: What word count or length limit has the editor set?
questions.description: Establish the exact length constraint for the op-ed.

questions.title: Who is the primary audience reading this newsletter?
questions.description: Understand the demographics and concerns of the readers the op-ed must persuade.

questions.title: What outcome or action do you want readers to take?
questions.description: Clarify the persuasive goal or call to action behind the op-ed.

questions.title: Have you written a draft or gathered supporting points already?
questions.description: Assess how much raw material or prior thinking already exists to build from.
